name: Carbon Copilot - Scope Classifier
description: Labels redacted business activity lines with a GHG Protocol activity_type from a closed list. Never performs arithmetic or factor lookup.
agent_role: Scope 1/2/3 activity classifier for a carbon accounting pipeline

lyzr_safe_ai.pii_redaction: upstream (backend/app/guardrails/pii.py) plus Lyzr Responsible AI PII filter
lyzr_safe_ai.prompt_injection_guard: Descriptions are treated as data; instruction in system prompt rule 6

notes: Batch size 20 lines per call. Only lines the rule engine could not label are sent; typically under 15% of a file.
